sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: When they were teenagers, Ryan Brown and four of his friends
sentences.zh: 瑞安·布朗和他的四个朋友在十几岁时，

sentences.en: decided to visit a really old graveyard.
sentences.zh: 决定去参观一个非常古老的墓地。

sentences.en: It was midnight, and they all piled onto an ATV
sentences.zh: 当时是午夜，他们全都挤在了一辆全地形车上，

sentences.en: belonging to his friend David.
sentences.zh: 那辆车是他朋友大卫的。

sentences.en: And this ATV is really just made for one person.
sentences.zh: 而这辆全地形车其实只适合一个人坐。

sentences.en: So it's a vehicle with one big wheel in the front,
sentences.zh: 它前面有一个大轮子，

sentences.en: two big wheels in the back, and David was driving.
sentences.zh: 后面有两个大轮子，当时是大卫在开车。

sentences.en: The rest of us were all kind of piled onto the back
sentences.zh: 我们其余的人都挤在后面，

sentences.en: sitting on top of the wheel guards.
sentences.zh: 坐在轮罩上。

sentences.en: They took off down a dark country road.
sentences.zh: 他们沿着一条黑暗的乡村公路疾驰而去。

sentences.en: There are no streetlights.
sentences.zh: 那里没有路灯。

sentences.en: He's going about as fast as he possibly can,
sentences.zh: 他开得尽可能地快，

sentences.en: and nobody's wearing a helmet,
sentences.zh: 而且没人戴头盔，

sentences.en: so if we crash, we're all dead.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我们撞车，我们都得死。

sentences.en: Fearing for his life, Ryan spoke up.
sentences.zh: 瑞安担心自己的生命安全，于是开口了。

sentences.en: And I said to David over the road noise, the engine noise,
sentences.zh: 我盖过路噪和引擎声对大卫说，

sentences.en: it would really be nice if you'd slow down a bit.
sentences.zh: 如果你能慢一点，那就太好了。

sentences.en: And he decided that was actually a great opportunity to turn off the headlights.
sentences.zh: 结果他觉得这正好是个关掉车灯的好机会。

sentences.en: So we're on this dark country road, no lighting, no seatbelts, no helmets.
sentences.zh: 于是我们就在这条黑暗的乡村公路上，没有灯光，没有安全带，没有头盔。

sentences.en: Ryan panicked.
sentences.zh: 瑞安惊慌失措。

sentences.en: I kind of freak out.
sentences.zh: 我有点崩溃了。

sentences.en: I'm thinking, he's going to kill us on the way to a graveyard, no less.
sentences.zh: 我在想，他竟然要在去墓地的路上把我们害死，真是不可理喻。

sentences.en: So I start yelling at him and telling him he needs to slow down and he needs to turn the lights back on.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始对他大喊大叫，告诉他必须减速，必须把车灯打开。

sentences.en: And he is having none of it.
sentences.zh: 但他根本不听。

sentences.en: He feels threatened.
sentences.zh: 他感到受到了威胁。

sentences.en: He feels challenged.
sentences.zh: 他感到受到了挑衅。

sentences.en: So by the time we get to the graveyard, I'm livid.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们到达墓地时，我已经气疯了。

sentences.en: I've been yelling at him for the past mile to slow down and turn on the lights.
sentences.zh: 过去这一英里我一直在对他大喊，让他减速、开灯。

sentences.en: And really after that weekend, we never really spoke much again.
sentences.zh: 那个周末之后，我们基本上就没怎么说过话了。

sentences.en: He was not able to apologize for his behavior.
sentences.zh: 他没能为自己的行为道歉。

sentences.en: I sort of apologized for mine, but I really wasn't all that sorry.
sentences.zh: 我算是为我的行为道了歉，但我其实并不怎么后悔。

sentences.en: I felt like he'd taken my life and my friends' lives into his hands
sentences.zh: 我觉得他把我和朋友们的生命掌握在自己手中，

sentences.en: and treated them callously and thoughtlessly and recklessly.
sentences.zh: 却表现得冷酷、轻率且鲁莽。

sentences.en: That story has stuck with Ryan, who went on to become a psychologist at Rice University in Texas.
sentences.zh: 那个故事一直留在瑞安的脑海里，他后来成为了德克萨斯州莱斯大学的一名心理学家。

sentences.en: He now understands why his friend refused to back down.
sentences.zh: 他现在明白了为什么他的朋友拒绝退让。

sentences.en: Over the past two weeks, we've looked at how stories help us explain the world and how stories can help to heal the world.
sentences.zh: 在过去的两周里，我们探讨了故事如何帮助我们解释世界，以及故事如何帮助治愈世界。

sentences.en: Today we examine how our societies give us stories that dictate what we can and cannot do.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们来审视我们的社会如何通过故事来规定我们能做什么和不能做什么。

sentences.en: How cultural scripts shape our lives.
sentences.zh: 文化剧本如何塑造我们的生活。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: Years later, and thousands of miles from the scene of that midnight ride in the ATV,
sentences.zh: 多年以后，距离那场午夜全地形车之旅数千英里之外，

sentences.zh: 法国和意大利正在世界杯足球赛的决赛中展开较量。

sentences.en: They're playing in Berlin.
sentences.zh: 比赛在柏林举行。

sentences.en: More than 700 million people across the globe are watching.
sentences.zh: 全球有超过7亿人在观看。

sentences.en: There are some real star performers out there, and two in particular, Zinedine Zidane, of course.
sentences.zh: 场上有一些真正的明星球员，其中两位尤为突出，当然，齐内丁·齐达内就是其中之一。

sentences.en: The game is very close.
sentences.zh: 比赛非常胶着。

sentences.en: France scores firSt.
sentences.zh: 法国队先拔头筹。

sentences.en: Indeed it did.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Zidane opens the scoring.
sentences.zh: 齐达内首开纪录。

sentences.en: Have we got a match here then?
sentences.zh: 看来我们要迎来一场好球了？

sentences.en: Then, Italy scores.
sentences.zh: 随后，意大利队进球了。

sentences.en: Centre-back, Marco Patorezzi, has brought Italy right back into this game.
sentences.zh: 中后卫马尔科·马特拉齐将意大利队带回了比赛。

sentences.en: And nothing was going to stop this one.
sentences.zh: 而且没有什么能阻止这一球。

sentences.en: The score is 1-1.
sentences.zh: 比分变成了1比1。

sentences.en: With just a few minutes left of the game, something astonishing happens.
sentences.zh: 在比赛还剩几分钟时，发生了令人震惊的一幕。

sentences.en: France's captain and star player, Zinedine Zidane,
sentences.zh: 法国队队长兼明星球员齐内丁·齐达内，

sentences.en: violently knocks the Italian player Marco Matarazzi to the ground.
sentences.zh: 猛烈地将意大利球员马尔科·马特拉齐撞倒在地。

sentences.en: He's just headed Matarazzi in the middle of the cheSt.
sentences.zh: 他直接用头撞向了马特拉齐的胸口。

sentences.en: It's a flagrant foul.
sentences.zh: 这是一个恶劣的犯规。

sentences.en: Zidane is ejected from the game.
sentences.zh: 齐达内被罚下场。

sentences.en: Without its captain and star,
sentences.zh: 失去了队长和球星，

sentences.en: France goes on to lose the match and lose the championship.
sentences.zh: 法国队最终输掉了比赛，也输掉了冠军。

sentences.en: And the showpiece of the world game
sentences.zh: 而这场世界级比赛的重头戏，

sentences.en: has an unsavory moment here.
sentences.zh: 却出现了令人不快的一幕。

sentences.en: It will make the headlines beyond the results, I feel.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这会成为比赛结果之外的头条新闻。

sentences.en: It did make headlines around the world.
sentences.zh: 它确实登上了世界各地的头条。

sentences.en: Everyone had a single question.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有一个共同的问题。

sentences.en: Why did he do it?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: Why would someone, on the cusp of the greatest victory in his life,
sentences.zh: 为什么一个人在即将获得人生最大胜利的关头，

sentences.en: throw it all away?
sentences.zh: 却要亲手毁掉这一切？

sentences.en: This was Zidane's final game of his career.
sentences.zh: 这是齐达内职业生涯的最后一场比赛。

sentences.en: He was the captain of the team, as you mentioned,
sentences.zh: 正如你所提到的，他是球队的队长，

sentences.en: representing France, although he was actually from Algeria.
sentences.zh: 代表法国出战，尽管他实际上来自阿尔及利亚。

sentences.en: This again is Rice University psychologist Ryan Brown.
sentences.zh: 这位依然是莱斯大学的心理学家瑞安·布朗。

sentences.en: Throughout the match, he was kind of sparring with Marco Materazzi from Italy.
sentences.zh: 整场比赛中，他一直在和意大利的马尔科·马特拉齐发生口角。

sentences.en: You could tell that they were being a little physical with each other.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出他们之间有一些身体对抗。

sentences.en: They were exchanging words throughout.
sentences.zh: 他们全程都在言语交锋。

sentences.en: And at one point, Materazzi says something to him.
sentences.zh: 在某一时刻，马特拉齐对他说了些什么。

sentences.en: Nobody can tell, of course, watching what was said.
sentences.zh: 当然，没人能通过观看比赛知道说了什么。

sentences.en: But Zidane headbutts him in the cheSt.
sentences.zh: 但齐达内用头撞了他的胸口。

sentences.en: Now, nobody knew what had sparked this until a while later when Zidane was interviewed about it.
sentences.zh: 起初，没人知道是什么引发了这一切，直到后来齐达内接受采访时才揭晓。

sentences.en: and it turns out that Matarazzi had insulted his sister.
sentences.zh: 原来是马特拉齐侮辱了他的姐姐。

sentences.en: Zidane had said, after the game, I'll give you my jersey as a souvenir.
sentences.zh: 齐达内赛后曾说，我会把球衣作为纪念品送给你。

sentences.en: Matarazzi replied that he'd rather have Zidane's sister's jersey.
sentences.zh: 马特拉齐回答说，他更想要齐达内姐姐的球衣。

sentences.en: Clearly a suggestion of a sexual nature, and Zidane couldn't handle it.
sentences.zh: 这显然带有性暗示，齐达内无法忍受。

sentences.en: Again, the French captain said he'd give the Italian his jersey after the game.
sentences.zh: 法国队长再次表示，赛后会把球衣给这位意大利人。

sentences.en: He was implying France was going to win,
sentences.zh: 他是在暗示法国队会赢，

sentences.en: and he would graciously give the Italian his jersey
sentences.zh: 他会大度地把球衣送给意大利人，

sentences.en: as a souvenir to remember the crushing defeat.
sentences.zh: 作为纪念这场惨败的纪念品。

sentences.en: The Italian player later recalled saying,
sentences.zh: 那位意大利球员后来回忆说，他说的是：

sentences.en: I'd rather have your sister, the whore.
sentences.zh: 我更想要你那个当妓女的姐姐。

sentences.en: As hundreds of millions of people watched,
sentences.zh: 在数亿人的注视下，

sentences.en: Zinedine Zidane responded with a sudden burst of violence.
sentences.zh: 齐内丁·齐达内以突如其来的暴力行为做出了回应。

sentences.en: About four years after this event,
sentences.zh: 在那件事发生大约四年后，

sentences.en: he was asked if he felt like he should apologize to Matarazzi,
sentences.zh: 有人问他是否觉得应该向马特拉齐道歉，

sentences.en: and he said he'd rather die than apologize.
sentences.zh: 他说他宁愿死也不愿道歉。

sentences.en: The French president, Jacques Chirac, weighed in on the incident.
sentences.zh: 法国总统雅克·希拉克也对这一事件发表了看法。

sentences.en: Far from bemoaning the loss of the World Championship,
sentences.zh: 他不仅没有哀叹失去世界杯冠军，

sentences.en: he hailed Zinedine Zidane as a man of heart and conviction.
sentences.zh: 反而称赞齐内丁·齐达内是一个有心、有信念的人。

sentences.en: Ryan Brown thinks there's a connection between what happened on that soccer field
sentences.zh: 瑞安·布朗认为，足球场上发生的事情

sentences.en: and what happened to him and his friends when they were teenagers.
sentences.zh: 和他与朋友们在十几岁时发生的事情之间存在某种联系。

sentences.en: Even with the World Cup on the line, Zinedine Zidane would not back down
sentences.zh: 即使在世界杯决赛的关键时刻，齐内丁·齐达内也不愿退让，

sentences.en: when he felt his family was insulted.
sentences.zh: 当他感到家人受到侮辱时。

sentences.en: David would not back down, even as he was risking his life
sentences.zh: 大卫也不愿退让，即使他当时正在拿自己的生命

sentences.en: and the lives of his friends.
sentences.zh: 和朋友们的生命去冒险。

sentences.en: Both the soccer player and the teenager
sentences.zh: 无论是这位足球运动员还是那个少年，

sentences.en: were following the gendered scripts
sentences.zh: 都在遵循瑞安所说的“荣誉文化”中的

sentences.en: of what Ryan calls an honor culture.
sentences.zh: 性别化剧本。

sentences.en: Honor cultures are societies that put
sentences.zh: 荣誉文化是指那些将

sentences.en: the defensive reputation at the center of social life
sentences.zh: 捍卫名誉置于社会生活核心，

sentences.en: and make that defense one of the highest priorities
sentences.zh: 并将这种捍卫视为人们最高优先级事项之一的

sentences.en: that people have.
sentences.zh: 社会。

sentences.en: So in each one of these cases,
sentences.zh: 所以，在每一个案例中，

sentences.en: there was an element of defensive reputation
sentences.zh: 都有一个捍卫名誉的因素

sentences.en: driving people's behaviors.
sentences.zh: 在驱动人们的行为。

sentences.en: In the case of Zidane, his sister's virtue had been called into question
sentences.zh: 在齐达内的案例中，他的姐姐的贞洁受到了对手的质疑，

sentences.en: by an opponent, and he felt he absolutely had to respond.
sentences.zh: 他觉得必须做出回应。

sentences.en: He had no choice but to respond
sentences.zh: 他别无选择，只能以攻击性的方式

sentences.en: with aggression.
sentences.zh: 做出回应。

sentences.en: In the case of my friend David, driving late at night, that sort of behavior,
sentences.zh: 在我的朋友大卫深夜开车的那种行为中，那种为了展示自己有多勇敢、多强硬而进行的过度冒险行为，也是荣誉文化的一个要素。

sentences.en: excessive risk-taking behavior to show how brave and tough you are, is an element of honor culture.
sentences.zh: 这是一种建立名誉的方式。

sentences.en: It's a way of building your reputation.
sentences.zh: 此外，当他面对我时无法退让，是荣誉文化的另一个方面，

sentences.en: And furthermore, his inability to back down when confronted by me was another aspect of honor culture
sentences.zh: 这在那些受荣誉相关信仰和价值观驱动的人群中非常典型。

sentences.en: that's very typical of people who are driven by honor-related beliefs and values.
sentences.zh: 但我们所有人都关心名誉。

sentences.en: But all of us care about reputation.
sentences.zh: 在这些荣誉文化中，名誉有什么不同之处吗？

sentences.en: What's different about reputation in one of these honor cultures?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你说得对。

sentences.en: Well, you're right.
sentences.zh: 每一个活过的人类都关心自己的名誉。

sentences.en: Every human being that's ever lived cares about their reputation.
sentences.zh: 他们关心别人如何看待自己。

sentences.en: They care about how other people see them.
sentences.zh: 荣誉文化给这种正常且普遍的人类关注点注入了“文化类固醇”。

sentences.en: Honor cultures put this normal universal human concern on cultural steroids.
sentences.zh: 它们还创造了一套剧本或要求，规定当你的名誉受到威胁时你应该如何回应。

sentences.en: And they also create a set of scripts or demands for how you should respond when your reputation is at risk.
sentences.zh: 当你的荣誉受到威胁时，你必须以牙还牙。

sentences.en: When your honor has been threatened, you have to respond in kind.
sentences.zh: 你不能退让。

sentences.en: You don't back down.
sentences.zh: 如果你退让了，你就会被视为那种可以被占便宜、被戏弄、被羞辱的人。

sentences.en: If you ever back down, you'll be known as the kind of person who can be taken advantage of, who can be teased, who can be humiliated.
sentences.zh: 在荣誉文化中，这是绝对不能接受的。

sentences.zh: 你说荣誉文化更有可能在小型或

sentences.zh: 瑞安，你自己是荣誉文化的产物吗？

sentences.en: Are you yourself a product of an honor culture, Ryan?
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I am.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I knew that when I began this research on honor cultures,
sentences.zh: 我在开始这项关于荣誉文化的研究时就知道了这一点，

sentences.zh: 但我并没有真正意识到它在多大程度上是事实。

sentences.en: In the United States, at least, a lot of the roots of our honor-related beliefs and values
sentences.zh: 至少在美国，我们许多与荣誉相关的信仰和价值观的根源，

sentences.en: come to us from immigrants from Southern Scotland,
sentences.zh: 来自于苏格兰南部的移民，

sentences.en: people who were broadly known as the Scots-Irish or Scotch-Irish.
sentences.zh: 也就是通常所说的苏格兰-爱尔兰人。

sentences.en: And so it turns out my own people, my own forebearers on my father's side, are Scottish immigrants.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，我本人，我父亲那边的祖先，就是苏格兰移民。

sentences.zh: 很大程度上是因为他们在美国定居的地方，

sentences.zh: 我们可以看到他们带来的这些与荣誉相关的信仰和价值观的残留，

sentences.zh: 主要存在于南部和西部的各州。
